summary: Backend-only testing for the new InfraLocal Market (construction ecosystem) endpoints. 15/15 new pytest cases passed (100%) against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Covered: GET /api/market/groups (6 groups with attached categories + suppliers_count>0 for cement/contractors/architects, no _id anywhere), GET /api/market/categories (24 total + filter by grp-materials returns 9), GET /api/market/suppliers (~26 suppliers with required fields rating/reviews/verified/featured/offerings, no _id) plus all filters (category_id=cat-cement -> 2, group_id=grp-materials -> >=8 all in materials cats, featured_only, verified_only, q=cement match by name/tagline/offerings, city=Jaipur), GET /api/market/suppliers/sup-01 returns attached category with name 'Architects', unknown id -> 404, POST /api/market/quote-requests happy path returns id starting with 'qr-' + status 'New' with Mongo persistence verified + cleanup, invalid supplier_id -> 404. Existing 25 tests were NOT rerun per request.

minor.issue: No Pydantic validators on mobile (any string accepted) and no length/format check on message. Also returns 200 instead of 201 on create; acceptable for MVP but consider 201.
Search parameter `q` uses raw regex without escaping user input — a value with regex special chars (e.g. '(' or '+') will 500 or match unexpectedly. Consider re.escape() before building $regex.

action_items: Optional: escape user-supplied `q` before feeding into MongoDB $regex on /api/market/suppliers to prevent regex-injection / 500s.
Optional: tighten QuoteRequest validation — enforce 10-digit mobile pattern and non-empty name/message; return HTTP 201 on create.
Optional: cap `limit` on /api/market/suppliers with an upper bound (e.g. min(limit,200)) to avoid unbounded reads.
critical_code_review_comments: list_market_groups mutates category dicts in-place while assigning suppliers_count — harmless because they come fresh from Mongo each request, but noteworthy if any caching layer is introduced.
get_supplier attaches `category` object; if a supplier has category_id pointing to a deleted category, `s['category']` becomes None (still valid JSON but frontend must handle null).
Seeding of suppliers/market_groups/market_categories is guarded by count==0 — updates to market_seed.py won't reflect unless collections are dropped. Consider a version key or CLI reseed helper.
CORS still wildcard ('*'); noted in previous iteration.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. One TEST_ quote_request was inserted by test_create_quote_and_persist and deleted in the same test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New market suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_market.py and runs in ~2s via pytest-xdist. Combined with the pre-existing /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (25 tests) the full backend can be run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Market seed data (6 groups, 24 categories, 26 suppliers) is idempotently seeded on startup when collections are empty.
